# Metric Glossary

<!-- Generated by `fol metrics --write` from the metric catalogs in src/front_office. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every metric the lab shows, as declared by its catalog entry. A screen takes a
metric's label, description and format from the same entry, so this document
describes what is on screen rather than what was once intended.

## Reading the tables

- **Origin** says where a number comes from:
  - `measured`: Published by the league - counted from the box score or from play-by-play - and passed through unchanged.
  - `derived`: Computed by the lab from measured totals, with the formulas in `src/front_office/analytics/formulas.py`.
  - `modeled`: Output of a fitted model: an estimate, not a fact. What the model is and how it was tested is in `docs/research/PLAYER_VALUE.md`.
- **Better** says which direction is good. Percentiles and ranks are oriented by it, so a
  high percentile always means good; where neither direction is better, it means high.
- A rate whose denominator is zero is missing, not zero.

## Player metrics

### Availability

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GP | Games played | `games_played` | measured | whole number | higher | Games the player appeared in. |
| GS | Games started | `games_started` | measured | whole number | higher | Games the player started. |
| GS% | Share of games started | `start_share` | derived | percentage | neither | Games started divided by games played. |
| GP% | Share of the season played | `games_played_share` | derived | percentage | higher | Games played divided by the number of games in the season. Low values mean injury, a late arrival or a small role. |
| MIN | Minutes | `minutes` | measured | whole number | neither | Total minutes played. |
| MPG | Minutes per game | `minutes_per_game` | derived | number | neither | Minutes divided by games played. |

### Scoring

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PPG | Points per game | `pts_per_game` | derived | number | higher | Points divided by games played. |
| PTS/36 | Points per 36 minutes | `pts_per_36` | derived | number | higher | Points scaled to 36 minutes, so players with different minutes can be compared. |
| PTS/100 | Points per 100 possessions | `pts_per_100` | derived | number | higher | Points per 100 team possessions while the player was on the court, which removes the effect of pace. |
| FG% | Field goal percentage | `fg_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | Field goals made divided by attempted. |
| 3P% | Three-point percentage | `fg3_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | Three-pointers made divided by attempted. |
| FT% | Free throw percentage | `ft_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | Free throws made divided by attempted. |
| eFG% | Effective field goal percentage | `efg_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | (FGM + 0.5 x 3PM) / FGA. Field goal percentage that credits a three as one and a half makes. |
| TS% | True shooting percentage | `ts_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | PTS / (2 x (FGA + 0.44 x FTA)). Scoring efficiency counting twos, threes and free throws together. |
| 3PM | Three-pointers made per game | `fg3m_per_game` | derived | number | higher | Three-pointers made divided by games played. |
| 3PA | Three-point attempts per game | `fg3a_per_game` | derived | number | neither | Three-point attempts divided by games played. |
| 3PAr | Three-point attempt rate | `fg3a_rate` | derived | percentage | neither | Share of field goal attempts taken from three: 3PA / FGA. |
| FTA | Free throw attempts per game | `fta_per_game` | derived | number | higher | Free throw attempts divided by games played. |
| FTr | Free throw rate | `ft_rate` | derived | number | higher | Free throw attempts per field goal attempt: FTA / FGA. How often a player gets to the line. |

### Creation

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| APG | Assists per game | `ast_per_game` | derived | number | higher | Assists divided by games played. |

| AST% | Assist percentage | `assist_pct` | measured | percentage | higher | Share of teammates' field goals the player assisted while on the court. Measured by the league from play-by-play. |
| USG% | Usage percentage | `usage_pct` | measured | percentage | neither | Share of team plays the player used - shots, free throws, turnovers - while on the court. Measured by the league from play-by-play. |

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Impact

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ORtg | On-court offensive rating | `off_rating` | measured | number | higher | Points the team scored per 100 possessions while the player was on the court. Measured by the league. |
| NetRtg | On-court net rating | `net_rating` | measured | signed number | higher | Team points scored minus allowed per 100 possessions while the player was on the court. Measured by the league. |

## Team metrics

### Record

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GP | Games played | `games_played` | measured | whole number | neither | Games played. |
| W | Wins | `wins` | measured | whole number | higher | Games won. |
| L | Losses | `losses` | measured | whole number | lower | Games lost. |
| W% | Winning percentage | `win_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | Wins divided by games played. |

### Scoring

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PPG | Points per game | `pts_per_game` | derived | number | higher | Points scored divided by games played. |
| Opp PPG | Points allowed per game | `opp_pts_per_game` | derived | number | lower | Points allowed divided by games played. |
| Diff | Point differential per game | `point_diff_per_game` | derived | signed number | higher | Points per game minus points allowed per game. It depends on pace: a fast team scores and allows more of both. |

### Efficiency

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ORtg | Offensive rating | `off_rating` | measured | number | higher | Points scored per 100 possessions. Published by the league for a season; estimated from box scores for a span of games. |
| DRtg | Defensive rating | `def_rating` | measured | number | lower | Points allowed per 100 possessions. Published by the league for a season; estimated from box scores for a span of games. |
| NetRtg | Net rating | `net_rating` | measured | signed number | higher | Offensive rating minus defensive rating: point differential with pace removed. |
| rORtg | Relative offensive rating | `rel_off_rating` | derived | signed number | higher | Offensive rating minus the league's average offensive rating that season, which makes offenses comparable across eras. |
| rDRtg | Relative defensive rating | `rel_def_rating` | derived | signed number | higher | The league's average offensive rating that season minus the team's defensive rating. Positive means better than average; comparable across eras. |
| TS% | True shooting percentage | `ts_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | PTS / (2 x (FGA + 0.44 x FTA)). Scoring efficiency counting twos, threes and free throws together. |

### Offense: four factors

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| eFG% | Effective field goal percentage | `efg_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | (FGM + 0.5 x 3PM) / FGA. Field goal percentage that credits a three as one and a half makes. |
| TOV% | Turnover rate | `tov_pct` | derived | percentage | lower | Turnovers per possession. |
| ORB% | Offensive rebound percentage | `oreb_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | OREB / (OREB + opponent DREB): the share of its own misses a team rebounds. This is the standard four-factors definition; the league's site publishes a differently defined, higher figure. |
| FTr | Free throw rate | `ft_rate` | derived | number | higher | Free throw attempts per field goal attempt: FTA / FGA. |

### Defense: four factors

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Opp eFG% | Opponent effective field goal percentage | `opp_efg_pct` | derived | percentage | lower | Opponents' (FGM + 0.5 x 3PM) / FGA. |
| Opp TOV% | Opponent turnover rate | `opp_tov_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | Opponent turnovers per possession: how often the defense forces one. |
| DRB% | Defensive rebound percentage | `dreb_pct` | derived | percentage | higher | DREB / (DREB + opponent OREB): the share of opponents' misses a team rebounds. |
| Opp FTr | Opponent free throw rate | `opp_ft_rate` | derived | number | lower | Opponents' free throw attempts per field goal attempt. |

Above 100% the group has played more minutes than one team has; below it, someone has to play more than before. |

## Benchmark measures

### Record

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| W/82 | Wins per 82 games | `wins_per_82` | derived | number | higher | Winning percentage times 82: a record on the scale of a full season, so that seasons cut short by a lockout or a pandemic compare with the rest. |
| Seed | Conference seed | `conference_rank` | measured | whole number | lower | Final position in the conference standings, as published by the league: the seed a team took into the postseason. |

## Player value

### Value

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IMP | Impact | `impact` | modeled | signed number | higher | Estimated effect on a team's net rating while the player is on the court, against the league's average minute, from this season alone. The player's own numbers are trusted in proportion to the minutes behind them. Points per 100 possessions on the court. |
| O-IMP | Offensive impact | `impact_offense` | modeled | signed number | higher | The part of impact that is points added on offense. Points per 100 possessions on the court. |
| D-IMP | Defensive impact | `impact_defense` | modeled | signed number | higher | The part of impact that is points saved on defense. Points per 100 possessions on the court. |
| WAR | Wins above replacement | `wins_added` | modeled | number | higher | Wins the season was worth over a replacement player in the same minutes: impact above replacement level, times the share of the team's minutes played, times the wins a point of net rating was worth that season. |
| MIN% | Share of team minutes | `minutes_share` | derived | percentage | neither | Minutes played over the team's game minutes, every team played for added up: 100% is every minute of every game. |
| REL | Reliability | `reliability` | derived | percentage | neither | Share of the season's impact that rests on the player's own numbers. The rest is what the model assumes of any player used that many minutes a game. |

### Value: where impact comes from

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EFF | Impact from scoring efficiency | `impact_from_efficiency` | modeled | signed number | higher | Points beyond what an average scorer gets from the same shots and free throws. |
| CRE | Impact from creation | `impact_from_creation` | modeled | signed number | higher | How much offense runs through the player: scoring attempts, assists, free throws. |
| SPC | Impact from spacing | `impact_from_shooting` | modeled | signed number | higher | Three-point attempts. Accuracy is counted under scoring efficiency; this is the worth of being a threat a defense has to follow. |
| REB | Impact from rebounding | `impact_from_rebounding` | modeled | signed number | higher | Offensive and defensive rebounds. |
| TOV | Impact from ball security | `impact_from_ball_security` | modeled | signed number | higher | Turnovers. |
| D-ACT | Impact from defensive activity | `impact_from_defensive_activity` | modeled | signed number | higher | Steals, blocks and fouls: the part of defense a box score records. |
| ON | Impact from on-court results | `impact_from_on_court` | modeled | signed number | higher | How the team scored and defended with the player on the court, against the same team over the whole season. |
| TEAM | Impact from team results | `impact_from_team_context` | modeled | signed number | higher | How the player's teams scored and defended against the league. Whatever a team does well that no box score records is shared among the players who were there. |
| BASE | Impact assumed | `impact_from_baseline` | modeled | signed number | higher | The part of impact that is assumed rather than shown: the level given to the share of the estimate the minutes do not vouch for, less the constant that puts the league's average minute at zero. |

### Value: going into the season

| Metric | Name | Key | Origin | Shown as | Better | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P-IMP | Projected impact | `projected_impact` | modeled | signed number | higher | Impact expected going into the season, from up to three seasons before it and the player's age. This is the estimate the model is tested on. Points per 100 possessions on the court. |
| P-OFF | Projected offensive impact | `projected_offense` | modeled | signed number | higher | The offensive part of projected impact. Points per 100 possessions on the court. |
| P-DEF | Projected defensive impact | `projected_defense` | modeled | signed number | higher | The defensive part of projected impact. Points per 100 possessions on the court. |
| P-REL | Reliability of the projection | `projection_reliability` | derived | percentage | neither | Share of the projection that rests on the player's own earlier numbers. Missing for a player with no earlier season, who is given the level of a new player. |
| P-MIN% | Projected share of team minutes | `projected_share` | modeled | percentage | neither | Share of team minutes expected going into the season, from the last three seasons' shares and age. It allows for the chance of not playing at all, and knows nothing of injuries or depth charts. |
| P-WAR | Projected wins above replacement | `projected_wins` | modeled | number | higher | Projected impact above replacement level, times the projected share of team minutes, times the wins a point of net rating is worth, over 82 games. |
